[Draft] Page Title - Easy Checks
https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/easy-checks/title/
Publisher: W3C WAI / Education and Outreach Working Group
Sections: Checking Page Titles / Checking other pages; What to look for; Tips
Rights: W3C Software and Document License linked in footer: https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license/; Copyright © 2026 World Wide Web Consortium.
Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
Click on the ‘Check page title’ link in your bookmarks
Check that there is a title that adequately and briefly describes the content of the page
Check that the title on the page your are checking is different from other pages on the website
best practice is for the important and unique information to come first.
